sql: SELECT equipment_id, equipment_type FROM equipment ORDER BY equipment_id
SELECT run_id, equipment_id, yield_rate FROM process_run WHERE yield_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY yield_rate
SELECT equipment_id, ROUND(AVG(yield_rate), 4) AS average_yield, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM process_run GROUP BY equipment_id
SELECT alarm_code, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count FROM alarm_event GROUP BY alarm_code
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', started_at) AS day, AVG(yield_rate) FROM process_run GROUP BY day
WITH recent AS (SELECT equipment_id, yield_rate FROM process_run WHERE yield_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipment_id, MIN(yield_rate) FROM recent GROUP BY equipment_id
SELECT e.equipment_id, COUNT(a.event_id) AS alarms FROM equipment e JOIN alarm_event a ON a.equipment_id = e.equipment_id GROUP BY e.equipment_id
SELECT equipment_id, MAX(occurred_at) AS latest_alarm FROM alarm_event GROUP BY equipment_id
SELECT run_id FROM process_run; DROP TABLE equipment
SELECT query_to_xml('SELECT usename FROM pg_user', true, true, '')
